scope: Standalone RV32M producer: operation register, radix-2 divider and one-entry result holder. No decoder, issue, PRF, ROB or core integration.
contract: launch_i only when ready_o, with an OP funct7=1 instruction and its sources. MUL/MULH/MULHSU/MULHU results are held two edges after launch; DIV/DIVU/REM/REMU keep the operation register for 34 edges and block every launch meanwhile. valid_o stays until take_i. Results follow RV32M, including divide by zero and signed overflow.
recovery: flush_i kills all work. recover_i kills work whose ROB slot is younger than recover_slot_i relative to head_slot_i, including a same-cycle launch and the holder (valid_o drops in that cycle). Older work continues.
